urls.rationale: M.G.L. Part I Title I Chapter 3 (The General Court) houses the legislative-agent / executive-agent lobbying registration and disclosure regime (sections 39-50), matching the MA 2010 vintage finding.

notes: MA Justia tree is 4-level (Part > Title > Chapter > Section). Intermediate fetch of Title I was required to expose chapter-level URLs. Chapter 3 is the single core_chapter; pass 3 will determine whether it is a chapter-TOC leaf or a directory of per-section leaves.
